title: Americans Want to Know When Their Healthcare Providers Use AI - CNET
summary: Of these survey participants, almost half (47%) say the health information generated by the chatbot was “extremely” helpful, and 48% said the information was “somewhat” helpful. The survey shows that Americans may find AI chatbots convenient, but not entirely trustworthy.
